title: The Ego and the Id (Das Ich und das Es)
author: Sigmund Freud
publisherOrJournal: Internationaler Psychoanalytischer Verlag / W. W. Norton
notes: Foundational formulation of the tripartite psychological structure and intrapsychic conflict.

title: Instincts and Their Vicissitudes (Triebe und Triebschicksale)
author: Sigmund Freud
notes: Examines vicissitudes of instinctual drives including sublimation and turning against the self.

title: Psychological Types (Psychologische Typen)
author: Carl Gustav Jung
publisherOrJournal: Rascher & Cie / Princeton University Press (Collected Works Vol. 6)
notes: Classic text establishing attitudes, cognitive functions, and the tension of psychological opposites.

title: The Relations between the Ego and the Unconscious
author: Carl Gustav Jung
notes: Conceptualizes the persona as social mask and the shadow as unintegrated personal potential.

title: The Neurotic Constitution (Über den nervösen Charakter)
author: Alfred Adler
notes: Introduces compensation and goal-oriented individual psychology dynamics.

title: Social Interest: A Challenge to Mankind
author: Alfred Adler
notes: Foundational text on Gemeinschaftsgefühl as a core index of psychological health and orientation.

title: Client-Centered Therapy: Its Current Practice, Implications, and Theory
author: Carl R. Rogers
notes: Presents 19 propositions on personality and the phenomenal field.

title: On Becoming a Person: A Therapist's View of Psychotherapy
author: Carl R. Rogers
notes: Defines congruence between self-concept and experience as central developmental orientation.

title: A Theory of Human Motivation
author: Abraham H. Maslow
notes: Classic peer-reviewed paper introducing the multidimensional hierarchy of human needs.

title: Toward a Psychology of Being (2nd ed.)
author: Abraham H. Maslow
notes: Explores metamotivation and Being-cognition in psychologically mature functioning.

title: Science and Human Behavior
author: B. F. Skinner
notes: Systematic application of operant principles to complex human behavioral patterns.

title: About Behaviorism
author: B. F. Skinner
notes: Addresses epistemological foundations of radical behaviorism and human agency.

title: The Principles of Psychology (Vol. 1 & 2)
author: William James
publisherOrJournal: Henry Holt and Company / Harvard University Press (1981 reprint)
notes: Masterwork establishing the material, social, and spiritual self, habit pathways, and consciousness.

title: Pragmatism: A New Name for Some Old Ways of Thinking
author: William James
publisherOrJournal: Longmans, Green, and Co. / Harvard University Press
notes: Applies pragmatic method to evaluate psychological attitudes and beliefs by their living consequences.

title: Gestalt Therapy: Excitement and Growth in the Human Personality
author: Frederick S. Perls, Ralph F. Hefferline, & Paul Goodman
notes: Foundational text integrating Gestalt perceptual laws with holistic personality and contact boundaries.

title: Laws of Organization in Perceptual Forms (Untersuchungen zur Lehre von der Gestalt II)
author: Max Wertheimer
notes: Defines holistic perceptual organization principles that the whole transcends the sum of its parts.

title: Man's Search for Meaning (...trotzdem Ja zum Leben sagen)
author: Viktor E. Frankl
publisherOrJournal: Verlag für Jugend und Volk / Beacon Press
notes: Philosophical foundation of logotherapy: meaning discovery through creative, experiential, and attitudinal values.

title: The Will to Meaning: Foundations and Applications of Logotherapy
author: Viktor E. Frankl
notes: Systematic presentation of logotherapy, self-transcendence, and the noological dimension of personality.

title: Depression: Clinical, Experimental, and Theoretical Aspects
author: Aaron T. Beck
notes: Pioneering formulation of core schemas and cognitive processing patterns.

title: Cognitive Therapy and the Emotional Disorders
author: Aaron T. Beck
notes: Comprehensive framework linking belief systems, situational appraisal, and emotional responses.
